whatsnew.label: Version 11.8
changes: 🎉 Nine new events come to the dungeon, each with its own enemies, bonuses and twist. Check the Events screen in the menu to see when each one is on.
🌼 Día de los Muertos (November 1–2) — a fallen hero from your Graveyard returns as a ghost and fights beside you. Earn Marigolds and spend them at 🌼 The Ofrenda.
🇲🇽 Independencia de México (September 15–16) — the ¡El Grito! battle cry gives you +30% attack for 3 turns, once a fight.
🎆 New Year (December 31–January 1) — double XP into the new year.
🐉 Lunar New Year — three days that move with the moon. Enemies sometimes leave a 🧧 red envelope with gold or a Mystery Coin.
🃏 Chaos Day (April 1) — every fight rolls a random twist.
🌑 The Longest Night (December 21) — it is night all day, with every night bonus on.
🌘 The Eclipse — one evening a month the sun goes dark, the same time for every player. Double gold, and much tougher enemies.
🏮 Night Market — the first weekend of every month, the merchant comes far more often and everything is 25% off.
🐾 Monster Migration — two days a month, enemies from the other dungeons wander into yours with all their abilities.

whatsnew.label: Version 11.7.3
changes: 🍎 Dungeon Descent has been rebuilt from the ground up as a native iPhone app in Swift. It's faster, smoother and works better with VoiceOver, and your characters and progress come with you.

🐛 Rebuilding every system found over 100 bugs in the old version, and every one is fixed: 105 skills that did nothing now work, spells finish what they start, subclasses, races, class traits, run modifiers, dungeon conditions and seasonal items all do what they say.
🏚️ Enemies in The Hollow and the Abyssal Deep use their real abilities: the Bell Ringer, the Wall Crawler, the Door Warden, the Twin, the Pressure Beast, the Deep Stalker and more.
📜 New: an opening quote for your class, an intro the first time you enter each dungeon, a boss preview before the floor 10 boss, and a class item in every floor shop.
👑 New: clear all eight dungeons to see the True Ending.
🏰 The Spire's bosses appear, the Gauntlet has its real last dungeon, the Siege can be won, and the Mine's enemies fight with their own moves.
🔒 The tournament leaderboard no longer shows players' email addresses.

whatsnew.label: Version 11.7.2
changes: 📜 Run Briefing — starting a run no longer stacks up to six pop-ups on top of each other. The quests, run modifier, dungeon condition, class trait, opening quote, dungeon intro, seasonal event and your guide's greeting are now one screen with one Begin Descent button. Nothing disappears on a timer, VoiceOver lands right on Begin, and the narrator reads the whole page.
🎓 The tutorial for new players now starts right when you begin your first run, instead of after your first fight.
🎃 Seasonal event pop-ups now only appear on the main menu, never in the middle of character creation or a run.
🔍 Your first search in every run always finds something, so a new run never opens with a trap.

🐛 Fixed the Back button on the Hunter Mode step of character creation going forward to the guide step instead of back. Also fixed the Run Mode step's Next button saying it goes to the backstory instead of the spirit step.
🐛 Fixed the Play button and other buttons being announced as headings when screen reader headings are on. Buttons stay buttons now.
🐛 Fixed combat messages running together for screen readers, like "Shield Bash!You attack".
🐛 Fixed the Daily Challenge being listed as active when you had not registered for it. The briefing now tells you to register in Challenges if you want to play it.
🐛 Fixed the Floor Complete summary always saying "Gold earned: 0".
🐛 Fixed the dungeon condition and your health sometimes showing different values at the start of a run, caused by the old pop-ups overlapping.
📱 On phones and tablets, the welcome message now says to swipe to explore the menu instead of pressing Tab.

whatsnew.label: Version 11.7.1
changes: 🐾 The Familiar — a small companion separate from your Guide that bonds with you across every run, persisted account-wide like your trophies. Bond grows from kills, room searches, and full dungeon clears. Custom naming, 4 unlockable species (100 trophies, clear every dungeon, defeat the Void Reaper, or reach Bond Level 10), bond-level titles at 5/10/20, a comfort line at critical sanity, and it recognizes Julio and the Void Reaper by name. 3 new achievements: First Bond, The Loyal, The Inseparable. Flavor-only on purpose — no stat effect, can't touch combat balance.

🎧 Echo-Location 2.0 — doors leading toward an unvisited room now layer a distinct cue for what's actually coming: a low growl for danger, a bright shimmer for something promising, a detuned "uncertain" tone for a mystery. A real read of the next room, not flavor. Also now senses corridor depth — a long hallway gets a longer fading tone plus a soft trailing echo, a single-room alcove stays short and tight.

🏹 Live directional Hunter — the hunter's heartbeat and proximity pulse are now panned to the direction it's actually coming from (the door behind you, since it's always following your trail), and update live on every beat instead of once per distance milestone.
⬇️ Descent cue — a falling pitch sweep plays when you actually descend a floor, reinforcing the "going deeper" feeling.

📱 Live Activity (iOS) and a live notification (Android) — Hunter distance or Endless Descent floor/points now show right on your lock screen (and Dynamic Island on iOS) while the app is backgrounded, for either Hunter Mode or an AFK run. Clears itself when either ends.
✌️ Magic Tap → Echo-Location — VoiceOver users can now fire Echo-Location from anywhere in 3D Mode exploration with a two-finger double-tap, no menu required.

🔊 Fixed VoiceOver/TalkBack burying 3D Mode's directional door and wall cues under the screen reader's own speech — they fire after the room announcement now instead of on top of it. Also added a native iOS audio session fix so game audio and VoiceOver speech share the device properly.

🐛 Fixed the What's New popup never actually showing on a version update — it was fully built but never wired up, and the popup element it needed didn't exist in the page yet. Also fixed a follow-on bug where every existing player got silently misread as a brand-new install the first time the fix went live.
🐛 Fixed the Void Reaper staying stuck on "Dormant" forever after being killed, if the player closed the app within 10 seconds of the killing blow.
🐛 Fixed Shake to Attack never working at all on iOS or in the browser — it was gated behind a plugin object that never actually existed on any platform.

whatsnew.label: Version 11.7
changes: 🕯️ Hide and Seek — in case it slipped past you: a tense chase mode against the Darkness Swallower, solo or with up to 5 friends in a shared room. Find the exit before it finds you. Been in the game for a while — it just never got its own mention here until now.

🎧 Echo-Location — a sonar-ping tool in 3D Mode. Fires a central ping then a panned tone per open door — a sharp tik where there's a wall, a soft fading tone where a door is. Pure audio, works even with the 3D visual off.
🎤 Voice Commands — play combat and exploration completely hands-free. Say "attack," "north," "defend," and more instead of tapping buttons. Native speech recognition on iOS and Android.
🏆 Trophy Room — a dedicated 3D space to browse everything you've earned.

📳 Expanded Haptic Vocabulary — dozens of new named vibration patterns (mimic reveals, undead rising, boss phase transitions, 3D Mode wall bumps, and more), and vibration duration is now actually respected instead of every buzz being the same fixed-length tap.

📖 Interactive Tutorial — the Combat step now has a real practice fight against a harmless training enemy, with live tips as you try Attack, Heavy Strike, and Defend. New step covering Voice Commands, Haptic Feedback, and 3D Mode/Echo-Location — features that existed but were never actually explained to new players.
🐛 Fixed the character list showing "undefined" instead of class, race, profession, or dungeon for characters saved before those fields existed — both browsing the list and importing an old save code.

🐛 Fixed the Command Center (text-command play style) character creator being badly out of date — 6 missing classes, a missing dungeon, and an entirely missing Profession step that silently gave every terminal-created character "Wanderer" instead of a real profession.

🐛 The Time Descender — this rare two-phase encounter could never actually occur due to a broken spawn check that's been in the game for a couple of versions. Fixed — it's a real, findable encounter now, legendary Chrono Armor drop and all.
🐛 Fixed gun counter-attacks silently never firing due to a call to a function that didn't exist.
🐛 Fixed Portuguese translation gaps across Siege, Raid, Boss Rush, Tournament, and Mine combat logs — these never translated anything, not even static text.
🐛 Added unlock hints to every locked achievement, so it's clear what to do instead of just "keep playing."
🐛 Fixed missing profession bonus descriptions for Street Rat, Warden, and Tinkerer.
🐛 Hardened save-data loading — corrupted or truncated storage (an interrupted save, an old format) now falls back safely instead of potentially crashing a screen.
🐛 Fixed the Sync to Cloud button announcing "Sync complete" even when the sync had just failed.
🐛 Fixed a missing error catch on multiplayer emotes, so a failed send no longer disappears silently.

whatsnew.label: Version 11.6
changes: 🧊 3D Mode (Beta) — explore every dungeon in a real 3D rendered view with full spatial audio. Walk between rooms yourself instead of tapping directions, and find the way out by sound and sight. Each dungeon has its own look: ashen lava for the Ashbound Wastes, ice blue for Frosthold Abyss, murky teal for the Sunken Archives, pale bone for the Hollow, mossy green for the Whispering Forest, hellfire red for the Infernal Descent, abyssal blue for the Abyssal Deep, and shadow purple for the Shadow World.

🎧 3D Mode works for screen reader players too — it's off by default when a screen reader is active, but you can turn it on yourself in Beta Features for enhanced spatial audio cues layered on top of the normal navigation.
⚙ New 3D Settings menu (appears once 3D Mode is on) — toggle Shadows, Torch Flicker, and an FPS Counter to balance visuals against performance on your device.

📴 Offline Support — this is an audio-first game, so it should work like one. Every sound effect, music track, and 3D Mode's visuals are now bundled directly into the app instead of streaming over the internet. Full gameplay, full audio, zero connection required.
🎖 Achievement Tiers — achievements now unlock in tiers with their own distinct unlock sounds, instead of one generic chime for everything.

🔊 Sound Overhaul — dozens of new and re-sourced sound effects across the game: per-dungeon enemy and boss combat stingers, core UI and gameplay sfx, Library narration, and a fixed footstep sound that was silently broken.

🐛 Fixed 6 music tracks that were silently broken — several dungeon battle themes (including Crypt of Malachar, the Ashbound Wastes, and Frosthold Abyss), the AFK theme, and the Christmas menu theme were corrupted files years oversized for what they should have been, tripping a safety limit and simply never playing. They're fixed and properly compressed now.
🐛 Fixed the shop's Refresh Items button crashing.
📜 Credits screen now properly attributes CC0 sound sources.

whatsnew.label: Version 11.5
changes: 🧪 Elixirs go to inventory — buying an elixir from the shop no longer uses it immediately. It goes to your Potions tab to save for when you need it most.
🗂 Potions tab now includes elixirs — all healing consumables live together in the Potions tab. Tap Use when you want to drink one.
🗺 Elixirs drop in dungeons — each dungeon now has a unique rare elixir that can drop from floor rooms. Volcanic, Void, Sylvan, Hollow, Shadow, and more.
🏆 Golden Elixir — combine any 3 elixirs from the Potions tab to brew a Golden Elixir. Fully restores HP and grants +8 ATK for 3 turns.
🧪 New achievement: The Alchemist — drink 10 elixirs across your runs to unlock it.
🏪 Elixir Vendor — a new shop with its own tab in the Home screen. Sell spare elixirs for gold, or buy a rotating daily elixir once per day.

🌋 3 new elixirs — Gravebound, Frostbound, and Tidal, bringing the vendor's rotation to 10 elixirs. Gravebound and Tidal also now drop and sell in the Crypt of Malachar and the Abyssal Deep; Frostbound stays vendor-exclusive.
📅 Daily Descent expanded from a 7-day loop to a 30-day cycle of unique rewards — gold, potions, soul fragments, mystery coins, and elixirs — before it repeats.
🐛 Fixed ATK and DEF boost potions never actually expiring — temporary attack and defense buffs now correctly wear off after their stated number of turns instead of lasting the rest of the run.

♿ Accessibility — translated 939 missing aria-labels to Portuguese, including the Security Room's escape directions and most combat, navigation, and menu labels. VoiceOver users should now hear far less untranslated English.

whatsnew.label: Version 11.4
changes: 🏆 Boss Loot — every dungeon boss now drops a unique relic when defeated. Eight relics total, one per dungeon, each with a passive effect that changes how you play the rest of the run.
👑 Malachar's Crown Fragment (Crypt) — +15 max HP and a one-time death prevention. If the Crown is active and you would die, it shatters instead and brings you back at 20% HP.
❤️‍🔥 Ember Heart (Ashbound) — burns enemies for 3 bonus damage on every attack you land.
🧊 Frostbite Shard (Frosthold) — 20% chance to freeze the enemy on hit, skipping their next attack.
📖 Drowned Tome (Sunken Archives) — +20 max SP and all skill costs reduced by 1.
🎭 Hollow Mask (The Hollow) — 15% dodge chance on every enemy hit, plus 3 floors of immunity from the Darkness Swallower in the Shadow World.
🌿 Sylvan Heart (Whispering Forest) — heals 3 HP every room you enter.
🔱 Infernal Brand (Infernal Descent) — +8 ATK and fire damage amplified by 25%.
🐉 Leviathan Scale (Abyssal Deep) — +25 max HP and reduces all incoming damage by 3.
🌑 Shadow Tear (Shadow World) — all player damage boosted by 12%.

whatsnew.label: Version 11.3
changes: ⚔ Boss Retry System — die to a boss and get one chance to try again. Retry costs 15% of your gold and restores you to 50% HP. The boss resets to full strength. One retry per run.

📷 Security Room — new Shadow World event. Four cameras (N/S/E/W), 15-second timer. The Darkness Swallower is on one feed — find it by sight or by growl, then escape the opposite direction. Wrong direction or time's up: 30% max HP damage and 1 corruption stack.
🧟 The Risen — new Hollow tier 1 enemy. Zombie that revives once at 20% HP when killed. You have to kill it twice.
🧛 The Pale Guest — new Hollow tier 2 enemy. Vampire that heals 8 HP every time it hits you. Kill it fast.
👻 The Unfinished — new Hollow tier 3 enemy. Ghost with a 30% chance to phase through your attacks entirely. Each with unique entrance sound effects.
⚔ Pre-Boss Gauntlet — 1 or 2 waves of buffed dungeon minions now spawn between the floor 10 elite and the final boss.
📦 Inventory stacking — identical items now show as a single row with a count. 59 enchanters = one button. Massive accessibility improvement for screen reader users.
🎭 Equipment tab — new inventory category for masks, relics, and unique items like the Shapeshifter's Mask.
🛡 Armor tab — armor now has its own inventory tab, separate from weapons.
🔍 Inventory search fix — typing in the search box no longer yanks focus away after every letter.
🐛 Stalker Floor direction bug fixed — ahead/behind labels were swapped on the Y axis. Now correctly reports which direction the Darkness Swallower is.
🌍 Portuguese translation complete — the game is now fully translated into Portuguese.

whatsnew.label: Version 11.2
changes: 🌑 Shadow World loot — 4 new items: Mirror Fragment (purge all corruption instantly), Echo Bone (relic, +25% vs Echo/Shapeshifter), Offering Cloth (relic, guarantees good Offering outcome), Door Key (relic, guarantees good Two Doors outcome)

🎭 Shapeshifter's Mask — now fully functional. Use in combat to copy the current enemy's ability. 12 different abilities including phase dodge, second life, reflection, void web, growing power, shadow command, and more.
🌑 Stalker Floor — The Darkness Swallower now has looping spatial growl audio and directional footsteps via equalpower panning. Growl stops immediately on escape, defeat, or fight.
🌑 Boss sequence — The Echo now always spawns first on floor 10. Defeating The Echo auto-triggers The Shapeshifter with a dramatic sequence.
🌑 Enemy pool — Shadow World enemies now spawn correctly everywhere (Cursed Chamber, ambush, regular combat). Abyssal enemies no longer bleed into Shadow World.
🎵 Music Player — added previous/next track buttons, shuffle toggle, volume slider, and now playing display that updates automatically.
📚 Library — ElevenLabs Brian narration added to The Merchant's Route, Before the Eye Opened, and The Founding Charter of the DDDI. Tap Listen to hear the story read aloud.
⚙️ Settings — Privacy Policy and Terms of Service links added alongside Support link.

🏚️ The Hollow — all existing enemies now have unique mechanics. The Portrait gains ATK each turn it watches. The Bell Ringer skips your turn on turn 2. The Wall Crawler bypasses defense every other hit. The Groundskeeper heals each turn. The Hollow Matron boosts her own damage. The Oldest Guest is immune to the first hit. The Caretaker grows stronger every turn.

whatsnew.label: Version 11.1
changes: 🌑 The Shadow World — 9th dungeon. 3000 years of darkness. 14 enemies with unique mechanics. Shadow Corruption builds per hit — at 3 stacks your damage is halved. Use Purge (4 SP) to clear it.

🌑 Shadow enemies — The Mimic (surprise double attack), The Lurker (hides first turn, critical second), The Reflection (mirrors your last action), Sorrow Hound (fear debuff -20% damage), Void Weaver (corruption web, break with Heavy Strike), The Twice Dead (returns at 50% HP after first kill), Shadow Archon (all enemies deal 15% more damage while alive)
🌑 Shadow Ambush — echoes of enemies you already killed this run return from the dark. Every echo adds corruption on hit.
🌑 The Shapeshifter — 4 phase boss. Phase 2 copies your weapon damage. Phase 3 matches your exact HP. Phase 4 corrupts on every hit. The hardest boss in the game.
🌑 The Void Reaper rebuilt on Firebase RTDB — date no longer resets on app reopen. Shared HP pool persists properly across all sessions.
📱 iOS — Audio overlap fixed. Startup audio on first touch. VoiceOver detection via native ScreenReader plugin. Shake to attack permission fixed. Notifications now fire correctly with custom sound.

🔔 Notifications — New preferences panel with 13 toggles. Weekly events (XP Weekend, Void Week, Blood Moon, Architect Week). New seasonal events (Brazil Day, Valentine's, St. Patrick's, Friday 13th, Ambush Day).

🎮 Bug fixes — Duplicate weapons no longer drop. Scrolls work correctly. Confirm dialogs replaced with accessible modals. Ambush combat button freeze fixed. getShopDiscount crash fixed. renderActionButtons crash fixed.
🎵 Shadow World music system — 7 tracks registered and wired into all audio systems. Shadow World tab in Music Player.
📋 Bestiary — Shadow World tab with 16 entries.

whatsnew.label: Version 10.9
changes: 📖 The Codex — a brand new lore system. Three tabs: World Lore, Enemy Lore, and Artifacts. Entries unlock through gameplay — clear a dungeon, kill enough enemies, reach Mine depth milestones, collect Void Fragments. 14 entries total to discover. Access from the main menu.
🎵 The Nocturnia Spire — new ambient orchestral music plays exclusively in the Codex. Also added to the Music Player catalogue.
⛏ Mine Exploration music added to the Music Player catalogue so players can listen to it from the Chronicles.

⛏ Mine Combat Overhaul — combat now features 6 actions: Attack, Heavy Strike (1.8x damage but enemy hits back harder), Defend (reduce incoming damage by 60%), Gun (uses your equipped gun), Potion (drink a found potion mid-combat), and Flee.

✨ Skills in the Mine — your unlocked class skills now work in Mine combat. Offensive skills scale by tier, healing skills restore 35% max HP, shield skills block 80% of the next hit, and buff skills double your next attack.
💊 Health Potions now drop in the Mine — from both digging and defeating enemies. Unused potions on surface are now saved to your global inventory instead of being lost.

👑 Mine Milestone Bosses — five named bosses now spawn at depth 10, 20, 30, 50, and 100. Each has unique lore, significantly higher HP, and drops guaranteed Mega Potion + 3 Diamonds. Added to the Bestiary with full lore entries.
⚔ Character stats now matter in the Mine — HP scales from your class HP map AND your character level. Attack damage scales with level too.
🎵 iOS Audio — volume slider now correctly adjusts music volume on iPhone and iPad. The saved volume setting is now preserved across refreshes. Music no longer restarts on every screen transition.
🎵 Music player now properly stops game music before playing, and resumes game music when stopped.
🎵 Music resumes correctly when returning from background or after long alerts on iOS.
📚 The Benjamin Sent Incident — a new Story Library entry. A totally true and historically accurate account of how Dungeon Descent saved Chernobyl. Written at 3 AM. All 12 chapters.
🏆 World Builder achievement repurposed — now awards for reaching Mine depth 50.
🏆 Spirit Forger achievement wired up — now correctly awards when you build a custom spirit.
🏆 Infernal Trial achievement fixed — now awards alongside Infernal Survivor when completing The Infernal Descent.
🐛 Fixed double volume announcement on iOS — percentage display spans no longer use aria-live, preventing JAWS/VoiceOver from reading both the label and the span simultaneously.

whatsnew.label: Version 10.8
changes: 🔫 Guns — a full new weapon system. 13 guns from the Flintlock Pistol to the AK-47. Each gun has a unique charge mechanic, shot count, and cooldown. Charge your gun, fire, then wait for the reload sound before charging again. Automatic guns fire multiple shots before cooldown. Guns work in dungeons, The Siege, and Raids.
💎 Diamonds — a new premium currency. Earned from boss drops (20% chance), rare chest finds, and deep mine exploration. Used to buy guns from the Blacksmith.

🔩 Gun Parts — crafting materials that drop from enemies (8% chance). Collect Barrels, Firing Mechanisms, Stocks, and Trigger Assemblies to craft guns at the Home crafting station instead of buying them.

⛏ The Mine — a brand new mode. Send a character into the mine to dig for diamonds, mystery coins, gold, and gun parts. Carry up to 15 items in your hands before surfacing. Descend deeper for rarer loot but tougher enemies. Mine-specific enemies: Cave Rat, Rock Beetle, Mine Wraith, Stone Golem, Diamond Golem, Ore Demon, and 13 more.
🎵 The Mine has its own music — creepy ambient exploration music and separate combat music when enemies spawn underground.
⛏ Mine Bestiary — 19 new mine enemies added to the Bestiary with full lore entries. Filter by the new Mine tab.

🗡 New enemies across all dungeons — The Ashbound Wastes, Abyssal Deep, Whispering Forest, and Infernal Descent all received new spawnable enemies with unique mechanics. Cinder Hound burns on every bite. Pressure Wraith grows stronger AND drains SP simultaneously. Canopy Horror gets stronger every turn it survives. Night Bloom poisons on every hit.
🐛 Fixed floor 10 elite guardian using Crypt enemies in all dungeons — Whispering Forest, Infernal Descent, and Abyssal Deep now correctly spawn their own tier 3 enemies as the pre-boss guardian.
🐛 Fixed Infernal Descent boss pool — was accidentally pulling from the default Crypt boss pool due to a dungeon name mismatch. The Hard Void and Infernal Architect now spawn correctly.
🐛 Fixed Abyssal Deep four-phase boss stopping at phase 3 — phase thresholds were not being scaled to the actual boss HP. Phase 4 now triggers correctly.
🐛 Fixed gun killing boss or floor 10 elite going straight to run summary — race condition resolved by setting victory flags immediately on kill.
🐛 Fixed AK-47 one-shotting entire ambush — gun now correctly removes only the targeted enemy from multi-combat and lets remaining enemies counter-attack.
🐛 Fixed Continue Journey button not showing after dungeon completion — button now correctly appears on the run summary screen.
🐛 Fixed true ending not triggering — the all-dungeons-cleared check was inside a try/catch that silently swallowed errors. Now runs independently and always fires.
🐛 Fixed level shown on character card not matching in-dungeon level — levels now save immediately on every level-up, not just at dungeon completion.

💾 Save data backup — critical save data (characters, gold, diamonds, achievements) is now mirrored to localStorage as a backup. If IndexedDB is ever evicted by the browser, your data is automatically restored on next launch.
🔧 Hardened error handling across achievements, global stats, legends, graveyard, and save systems — individual failures no longer cascade into larger crashes.
🌐 Language preference fix — Portuguese and Spanish players no longer see a brief English flash on page load after the IndexedDB migration.

whatsnew.label: Version 10.7
changes: 🗄️ IndexedDB Migration — save data has been moved from localStorage (5-10MB limit) to IndexedDB (unlimited). Your characters, progress, achievements, bestiary, and all settings have been automatically migrated. No data was lost.
⚡ Storage engine is now future-proof — as the game grows with new features and categories, save data will no longer be at risk of hitting browser storage limits.
🎵 Music loop fix — the loop-all feature no longer stops silently when an audio track fails to load. It now skips the unavailable track and continues to the next one.
🐛 Migration animation on first launch after upgrade — a brief progress screen shows while data is being transferred. This only appears once.

whatsnew.label: Version 10.6.5
changes: 🐛 MAJOR FIX — found and fixed the root cause of combat freezing after boss kills and "no enemy found" spell errors. The global watchdog was interrupting boss death cinematics and other multi-second combat transitions, wiping combat state mid-animation. Added a cinematic protection flag so the watchdog now waits for cinematics to finish before checking combat state.
🐛 Fixed normal (non-boss) enemy deaths not clearing combat state before entering the next room, causing the same freeze on any floor.
🐛 Fixed victory screen sometimes failing silently after boss kills — now wrapped safely so the game always shows something instead of freezing.
💘 Valentine's Day Event — active February 13-15. 7 exclusive enemies including The Cupid, who always drops a Love Potion.
💘 Love Potion — use on any non-boss enemy to charm it into fighting for you for 2 turns before it turns back against you.
💝 The Heartbreaker — Valentine's Day boss. Can charm you with a 35% chance per turn, forcing you to skip your next attack.
🍫 Chocolate Shop — earn Chocolate during the event. Spend on Love Potions, Box of Chocolates, Enchanted Rose, Cupid's Arrow, Heart Shield, and the exclusive Beloved title.
🐀 Coward enemy mechanic — weak enemies now flee when you're above 80% HP or on a 3+ kill streak, dropping gold as they run.

whatsnew.date: Ordem e Progresso — The Brazil Independence Day Update
whatsnew.label: Version 10.6.4
changes: 🇧🇷 Brazil Independence Day — September 7th only. Independência do Brasil. 1822.
⚽ O Craque — kicks an enchanted football at you instead of fighting normally. It hurts more than it should.
🐆 A Onça, 🐊 O Jacaré, 🦜 O Papagaio, 🐍 A Cobra, 🦅 O Gavião, 🐬 O Boto Cor-de-Rosa — 7 Brazilian enemies.
👑 O Rei do Carnaval — the boss. He came to celebrate. You interrupted the celebration. He will not forgive this.
🔑 Secret console code — type BRAZIL in the secret console on September 7th only for a special reward. The code does nothing on any other day.
